critical_code_review_comments: iter-69 breakout_scalper.compute_breakout_scalper correctly returns full shape on short history (ready:false, signal:NONE) — defensive contract that lets ai_signals.py safely merge without None-checks. Donchian-20 + ATR break_distance_atr >= 0.25 threshold is appropriately conservative (filters out drift, surfaces only meaningful range breaks).

iter-69 vwap_pullback.compute_vwap_pullback gracefully falls back to typical-price average when volume==0 across bars — important for synthetic/backfilled history. above_extended / below_extended regime gating correctly suppresses pullback signals when price has run too far from VWAP, which aligns with the bot's patience-first philosophy.

iter-69 learned_meta._fit_artifact threshold (MIN_SAMPLES_XGB=100) keeps XGBoost reserved for when there's actual signal density, falling back cleanly to logreg below that. Artifact discriminator via backend:'xgboost'|'logreg' + xgb_model_b64 vs weights is explicit and forward-compatible.

iter-69 routes/insights_routes.py keeps ai_reflection opt-in via include_ai=true — good for latency and cost (no Claude call on every dashboard refresh). The _generate_ai_reflection short-circuit to None when EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is absent is the right escape hatch for test/CI environments.

iter-69 email_sender uses asyncio.to_thread to wrap the synchronous Resend SDK call — correct pattern for keeping the FastAPI event loop unblocked. is_configured() bool helper makes the endpoint deterministically return configured:true|false without leaking the key.

Frontend WeeklyDigestPanel correctly treats both ok:true (success banner) and ok:false (error banner) as terminal states — exactly the agent-to-agent contract: 'frontend treats both as a non-broken state'. No infinite spinner risk.
